sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as missing person report.
Subsequently in the statements under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she had gone out of her own freewill and had married with the applicant.
There is no definite proof with regard to the age of the victim except the school leaving certificate which according to the applicant is forged and fabricated.

3. The issue with regard to the age shall be determined at the time of trial in view of the law laid down by this Court in the case of Monish vs State of U.P., (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.55026 Govind Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173973628/
1 of 2021), decided on 09.02.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 02.01.2023 and has no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Govind Singh be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.550 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Kheri, District Kheri on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
